title: Medicine ball core workout… the burn is real but the results are worth it. 💪🔥
description:
Showing up for yourself in the gym is not always easy, but it’s always worth it. This medicine ball workout really challenged my core strength and endurance. The burn is real, but every rep is a reminder that growth comes from pushing through the hard moments.

Fitness is about consistency, discipline, and believing in yourself enough to keep going. Keep showing up, keep working, and the results will come.
